chitchat: The archivist reshelves a file with the tenderness of a burial.
"Everyone is on record here. Being on record is not the same as being alive."
description: A stooped archivist who has memorised the location of files for people who no longer exist, and treats each one as a small held breath.

bye.text: She has already returned to the dead.

root.text: The archivist does not look up from the stacks. "If you seek a record, give me a name. If you seek a person, I cannot help you; we stopped stocking those."

name: an archivist
